An upbeat, major-key electronic pop track with a steady percussive beat plays in the background at a moderate volume. A digital 'ding' sound effect highlights a transition. (2) As the speaker describes the game mechanic, his voice maintains a high pitch variability, shifting between explanatory and surprised tones. Faint sounds of digital menu clicks are audible. (3) A sudden burst of high-arousal laughter from the speaker interrupts the speech. The music continues consistently. Sound effects of a character's lightning skill (electric crackle and impact) are clearly heard over the mix. (4) The speaker's arousal increases further, shouting phrases like 'Woah!' and 'How is this possible?'. The speech rate remains fast. Comic sound effects (like a slide whistle or a 'boing') are subtly layered during the glitch demonstration. (5) The speaker concludes with a more relaxed but still laughing tone, expressing humorous defeat. The BGM maintains its upbeat tempo until the track cuts off cleanly at the end.
